name: rl_bench_eval
description: rl_bench_eval is a reinforcement-learning benchmarking dataset/toolkit for evaluating RL agents across environments and tasks; it provides standardized episode traces, metrics, and wrappers to compute returns and success rates. The benchmark is intended to enable reproducible comparisons of policy optimization and control algorithms using common evaluation protocols and aggregated metrics. It focuses on episodic returns, sample efficiency, and stability of training across tasks.
evaluation_method: cumulative episodic return (average return), sample efficiency and task_success_rate
reputation: A community-contributed RL evaluation collection on Hugging Face — useful for reproducible experiments but with limited mainstream benchmarking adoption.
